entities.name: Philipp Friedrich Gmelin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Philipp Friedrich Gmelin was a professor of botany and chemistry. He studied the chemistry of antimony and wrote texts on the pancreatic ducts, mineral waters, and botany.
